The '''cavitation hyperdrive''' was a type of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].

==History==
The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] mathematician [[Q-Viza]] was credited with its invention and it was used by the Calamari to allow them to establish colonies on [[Ruisto]], [[Mantan]] and [[Hinakuu]] between [[4400 BBY]] and [[4200 BBY]]. However, it was exponentially slower than the standard [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] hyperdrive, which limited the territorial expansion of the Mon Calamari.
